scope: The seven source templates expanded by kernels/a64.py; every non-FEAT_CMPBR instruction assembled independently by Apple LLVM clang -cc1as (17.0.0) with exact .text byte counts, and all FEAT_CMPBR (cbhs/cbhi/cbeq) instructions verified for syntax, operand widths, and +-255-instruction reach by kernels/a64.py (replaced 1:1 by 4-byte nop placeholders solely during the LLVM-17 -cc1as syntax/size pass because Apple LLVM 17 predates FEAT_CMPBR). This does not prove parser semantics or a full linked callback executable.

adr.a64_py: ADR Xd,label (base A64): shape rl, reach +-1 MiB, writes 4 x the label's instruction index
adr.llvm_cc1as: assembled natively with every other instruction of generic_route

cmpbr.a64_py: FEAT_CMPBR cbhs/cbhi/cbeq: 4-byte instructions, reach +-255 instructions (verified by a64_load and simulated in experiment.py)
cmpbr.llvm_cc1as: Apple LLVM 17.0.0 predates LLVM 21 FEAT_CMPBR; replaced 1:1 with 4-byte nop in the -cc1as pass and verified natively by a64.py

limitations: Source macro expansion used kernels/a64.py; Apple LLVM 17.0.0 -cc1as independently assembled every non-FEAT_CMPBR instruction and checked exact .text byte counts.

Apple LLVM 17.0.0 predates Armv9.6-A FEAT_CMPBR (cbhs/cbhi/cbeq); those instructions (all in leaf.s) were verified by kernels/a64.py (reach +-255 insns, simulated in experiment.py) and substituted 1:1 by 4-byte nop placeholders during the -cc1as pass.
Raw macros with spaced arguments require quoting; the expanded source is the tested input.
No claim of a linked complete production executable or synthesized hardware.
The default experiment validates hashes and counts; it does not invoke clang.
